comparisons: Each restricted context against UNIVERSAL with the same scorer; each learned scorer against rules within the same context.

full_ec_reference.interpretation: Positive-reference support only; nonmatches are unconfirmed, and missing reference coverage is not biological absence.
full_ec_reference.population: Every positive exact EC assertion on every reference protein in the registered test genomes, including absent candidates.
full_ec_reference.ranking: Descending probability then lexical EC; report top-score ties and top-1/3/5 over all emitted candidates.
full_ec_reference.thresholds: Use the frozen mixed GO/EC calibration cutoffs and 0.5 without EC-specific retuning.

population: All frozen test supervision rows within each transfer regime; no supported-only selection or cross-regime pooling.
scope:
Matched final-score comparison of observed-gap context modes.

All frozen supervision rows, including unsupported learned rule fallback, remain
included. Calibration selects thresholds before test metrics. This reused cohort
measures reference support, not biological accuracy; unconfirmed is not a proven
negative. Sparse gap-linked supervision and reference overlap prevent claims of
missing-enzyme recovery or unseen-family generalization. No model is promoted.
thresholds: Separate max-F1 thresholds from complete calibration rows; ties choose higher threshold. Also report common fixed 0.5.
uncertainty: Descriptive percentile resampling of four previously examined test genomes; not a calibrated population confidence claim.
